summary: Ascent Industries Co. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of substantially all assets of Midwest Graphics Sales Inc. and Sigma Coatings, Inc. for $14,000,000, subject to working capital adjustments. The transaction closed on May 4, 2026, concurrently with signing. A portion of the purchase price is held in escrow for 18 months to cover adjustments and indemnification. BMO Bank consented as lender. No price per share, equity consideration, or premium is stated; it's an asset purchase. Watch for post-close working capital adjustments and integration risk.
